dct_description_sm: Currently there is a lack of data on the mercury and methylmercury content of Arctic multiyear sea ice.  Cores were taken to meet the following objectives; 1) To investigate the main variables governing total mercury distribution within multiyear sea ice; 2) To investigate the potential of mercury transformation within multiyear sea ice; and 3) To estimate the flux of mercury into the Arctic Ocean system upon complete multiyear sea ice ablation.   This data will be compared to recent data on mercury concentrations in first-year Arctic sea ice.
dct_title_s: Total Mercury and Methylmercury Profiles in Multiyear Sea Ice in the Southwestern Beaufort Sea
